title: Clamped Volume Knob
prompt_md:
## Goal
Define a `Volume` class that keeps a volume level inside the valid range [0, 100]. Outside code can read the level with a getter and change it with a setter, but the setter must never let the stored level leave that range.

## Input
Two integers on separate lines: the first value to set, then the second.

## Output
Two lines: the stored level after each `setLevel` call, each clamped to [0, 100].

## Feature
This exercises access functions (getters and setters): a `const` getter that returns the level, and a setter that validates its argument before storing it.

title: Forward-Only Odometer
prompt_md:
## Goal
Define an `Odometer` class that records how many miles a vehicle has driven. Mileage can only increase, so the mutator that adds miles must ignore any non-positive amount.

## Input
Two integers on separate lines: the first mileage amount to add, then the second.

## Output
Two lines of the form `Miles: <value>`, printed after each add.

## Feature
This exercises a getter plus a validating mutator (setter): the mutator enforces a rule — only positive amounts change the stored mileage — that a bare public data member could not enforce.
